events.name: Bash
events.head: Compare local branch with origin, find T-458 commits
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; git fetch -q origin series-deck-finish 2>&1|tail -2; git rev-parse HEAD origin/series-deck-finish; git rev-list --count origin/series-deck-finish..HEAD; git rev-list --count HEAD..origin/series-deck-finish; git log --oneline --grep "T-458" | head -5; git branch -r --contains $(git log --format=%h --grep "Agent T-458" -1) | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check T-458 commits on origin and unpushed commits
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; for c in 88e032d6 57bba71b db0f566b 8974c272 55d82466; do echo "$c $(git merge-base --is-ancestor $c origin/series-deck-finish && echo on-origin || echo NOT)"; done; git log --oneline origin/series-deck-finish..HEAD | head -20; git diff --stat origin/series-deck-finish..HEAD | grep -iE '\.env|\.pem|secret|CLAUDE.md|settings.json' | head
